Paragraph: "The gentle breeze stirs the lake, creating ripples that shimmer like liquid silver under the sun..."
Situation/Problem_Faced: Watching wind create shimmering wavelets across Lake Pampa.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Rama carefully describes the light playing across moving water.
Outcome/Resolution: He engages in calm visual observation.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Taranga (Ripples on water symbolizing subtle thoughts on the surface of consciousness)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Ripples shimmering on water represent transient thoughts moving across the surface of pure awareness.
Brief_Summary_Psychological: Visual mindfulness: focusing on fluid, natural patterns to induce mental composure.
